Name: No Big Lake in Forest Farm
Author: PrinceLothar
Description: There is a very large lake right in the middle of the Forest Farm. Of course, this lake is placed there to prevent the forest farm from being more "overpowered" than some of the other farms, but if you're like me and just want a nice area to grow a large orchard or raise animals, then this mod is for you. It simply removes the large lake.
